title: Agentic Turtles Executor Configuration
description: WHICH agent builds (FR-059). Operator configuration, not a stored record. The system ships one conformant executor and requires none — anything runnable by GitHub Agentic Workflows that satisfies contracts/build-executor.md is legitimate, and the gates and the deterministic writer must not be able to tell the difference (SC-019). The shape exists so provenance is recordable (FR-065) and so one prohibition is enforceable at config load rather than trusted: the spawned tier's guardrailed runner (FR-066).

id.description: Recorded on every deliverable this executor produces (FR-065).

tier.description: in-sandbox = a gh-aw-compiled workflow; containment is STRUCTURAL (compiled, SHA-pinned, scanned, egress-allowlisted). spawned = an operator-supplied image driving execution outside the gh-aw container; containment is CONDITIONAL and the operator supplies it.

engine.description: gh-aw compile-time engine selection. Required for the in-sandbox tier — the constitution's standing multi-engine constraint is that this is selectable per workflow, so it must be stated.

image.description: Container image ref. Spawned tier only; gh-aw owns the image in-sandbox.

model.description: Must exist in gh-aw's pinned AI-credits catalog or the proxy rejects the run.

requires_operator_merge.description: The FR-062 merge checkpoint, escalation-only by construction: true ADDS an operator checkpoint. No value removes one a gate demands — a step carrying an external authority's confirmation always waits for the operator, whatever this says.

guardrailed_runner.description: FR-066. Required for the spawned tier and enforced at config load, not documented and hoped for. Both allowlists must be NON-EMPTY: an empty allowlist is not 'no restriction stated', it is 'everything permitted'.
